hero.eyebrow: Est. 1892 · Eparchy of Saint Maron of Brooklyn
hero.heading:
Saint Maron Church
Maronite Catholic
hero.lede:
One of the first Maronite parishes in North America, Saint Maron Church has faithfully served the faithful in South Philadelphia since 1892. For generations, our parish has been a home of prayer, worship, and communion, preserving and sharing the rich spiritual heritage of the Maronite Catholic Church.

On Saturday, December 2, 2017, we gave thanks to God as we celebrated the 125th anniversary of our parish. We remember with gratitude all those who, through their faith, sacrifice, and devotion, helped build the parish we cherish today.

Rooted in the faith of our fathers and strengthened by the grace of God, Saint Maron continues its mission of proclaiming the Gospel and celebrating the Sacred Mysteries. All are welcome at the Table of the Lord.

parish.eyebrow: Ordination to the order of Priests
parish.heading: Keep Deacon Nadim Khaled in Your Prayers
parish.caption: Join us Sunday, September 13, 2026
parish.story:
Please keep Deacon Nadim in your prayers as he prepares to answer ‎God’s call to the priesthood. May the Lord strengthen him, ‎guide him, and fill his heart with His love and grace. May ‎He make him a faithful servant, a compassionate shepherd, ‎and a joyful witness to the Gospel.‎

Lord, bless him and prepare him for the sacred ‎ministry to which You have called him. May he always ‎remain close to You and faithfully serve Your people.‎

In Jesus’ name we pray. Amen.‎

sections.heading: Kitchen Upgrade
sections.text:
We Need Your Support
We invite you to be part of this important project. Every gift makes a difference, and together, our community can make this kitchen upgrade possible.

Whether you are able to make a small contribution or a larger gift, your generosity will be deeply appreciated. We also ask you to keep this project in your prayers and share this appeal with others who may wish to support our parish.

Thank you for standing with us and for helping us strengthen the place where fellowship, celebration, and service come together.

callout.heading: Support the mission of our parish
callout.text: Your generosity sustains our liturgies, our building, and our outreach to the community.
